title: Florence Lost Half
sentences: It was one of the richest cities in Europe.
Within months, there weren't enough people left to bury the dead.
Historians estimate the city lost around half of its people.
The writer Boccaccio watched it happen, and wrote it all down.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
Florence may have lost half its people in a single year.
